title: Independent read-only QA, synthesis and final program lock
qa_independence: A read-only verifier must recompute schema, calendar, hashes, row counts and conservation identities from exported files rather than trusting exporter summaries.
required_checks: unique Reach-day, Reach-month, reservoir-day and reservoir-month keys
complete calendar and conditional formal period
reservoir pre-activation identity and post-activation state continuity
reservoir mass, source-tracer and age-moment closure
hydraulic exposure recomputation from model flow and Andreadis geometry
2025 source flag and PET bridge decision consistency
absence of TN observations and forbidden reference-discharge use
